import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Create a comprehensive figure with multiple subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 10))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 3, hspace=0.3, wspace=0.3)

# Set style
sns.set_palette("husl")

# 1. Sleep Duration vs Quality of Sleep by Sleep Disorder
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, :2])
for disorder in df['Sleep Disorder'].unique():
    if pd.isna(disorder):
        subset = df[df['Sleep Disorder'].isna()]
        label = 'None'
    else:
        subset = df[df['Sleep Disorder'] == disorder]
        label = disorder
    ax1.scatter(subset['Sleep Duration'], subset['Quality of Sleep'], 
               alpha=0.6, s=50, label=label)
ax1.set_xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_title('Sleep Duration vs Quality by Sleep Disorder', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
ax1.legend(title='Sleep Disorder', loc='best')
ax1.grid(alpha=0.3)

# 2. Average Sleep Duration by BMI Category
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
bmi_sleep = df.groupby('BMI Category')['Sleep Duration'].mean().sort_values()
colors = sns.color_palette("coolwarm", len(bmi_sleep))
ax2.barh(bmi_sleep.index, bmi_sleep.values, color=colors)
ax2.set_xlabel('Avg Sleep Duration (hrs)', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_title('Sleep Duration by BMI', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.grid(axis='x', alpha=0.3)

# 3. Stress Level Distribution by Gender
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
df.boxplot(column='Stress Level', by='Gender', ax=ax3)
ax3.set_xlabel('Gender', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_ylabel('Stress Level', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_title('Stress Level Distribution by Gender', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
plt.sca(ax3)
plt.xticks(rotation=0)
ax3.get_figure().suptitle('')

# 4. Physical Activity Level vs Sleep Quality
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])
scatter = ax4.scatter(df['Physical Activity Level'], df['Quality of Sleep'], 
                     c=df['Stress Level'], cmap='RdYlGn_r', s=50, alpha=0.6)
ax4.set_xlabel('Physical Activity Level', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_title('Physical Activity vs Sleep Quality\n(colored by Stress)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
cbar = plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=ax4)
cbar.set_label('Stress Level', fontsize=9)
ax4.grid(alpha=0.3)

# 5. Heart Rate vs Daily Steps
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 2])
ax5.scatter(df['Daily Steps'], df['Heart Rate'], alpha=0.5, s=30, c='coral')
z = np.polyfit(df['Daily Steps'], df['Heart Rate'], 1)
p = np.poly1d(z)
ax5.plot(df['Daily Steps'].sort_values(), p(df['Daily Steps'].sort_values()), 
        "r--", alpha=0.8, linewidth=2, label=f'Trend line')
ax5.set_xlabel('Daily Steps', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_ylabel('Heart Rate (bpm)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_title('Heart Rate vs Daily Steps', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax5.legend()
ax5.grid(alpha=0.3)

# 6. Sleep Disorder Distribution
ax6 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 0])
disorder_counts = df['Sleep Disorder'].fillna('None').value_counts()
colors_pie = sns.color_palette("pastel", len(disorder_counts))
ax6.pie(disorder_counts.values, labels=disorder_counts.index, autopct='%1.1f%%',
       startangle=90, colors=colors_pie)
ax6.set_title('Sleep Disorder Distribution', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')

# 7. Age Distribution by Occupation (top 6)
ax7 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 1:])
top_occupations = df['Occupation'].value_counts().head(6).index
df_top_occ = df[df['Occupation'].isin(top_occupations)]
sns.violinplot(data=df_top_occ, x='Occupation', y='Age', ax=ax7)
ax7.set_xlabel('Occupation', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax7.set_ylabel('Age', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax7.set_title('Age Distribution by Top 6 Occupations', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax7.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
plt.setp(ax7.xaxis.get_majorticklabels(), rotation=45, ha='right')
ax7.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# Main title
fig.suptitle('Sleep Health and Lifestyle Analysis Dashboard', 
            fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
